subject: tr-def
title: TR.DEF.------T.C.IMP.
description: Chart on book p. 35 (BK(NM)-11). TR-DEF (trans-definition) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. From the subject: A-PR (all-purpose) and COS-P (cosmic particulars). From A-PR: UNI-PI. From COS-P: PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental) and PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental). From PER-VT-U-FUND: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). From DYM-SPT: AFI (affinity insight). From PER-PHY-U-FUND: SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics). From SCI-DYM: IST-F (isolated focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
